title: Stratton and Lacatski built OSAP together

tellings.quote: He and Lassky are the ones that built the OSAP program together. So it wasn't just Jim Lowsky alone. It was Jim and Jay and their support staff.

plain: A secret study program inside the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Pentagon's military spy agency, was built by two officials together, Jay Stratton and Jim Lacatski, and not by Lacatski alone. The program is known as OSAP and looked into unexplained aerial reports. This comes from Eric W. Davis, a physicist who worked on Pentagon UFO studies and says he took part. He says "it was Jim and Jay and their support staff," which would give Stratton a bigger role in the program's beginnings than is usually credited.
